audience: businesses that send offers and track clients and invoices in Billify

useCases.title: Find a client before you add one
useCases.text: Search the newest 100 clients by company name, and read one client's contact details and number of invoices.

useCases.title: Create a client and an offer draft
useCases.text: Create a client, or get the existing client with the same name. Then create an offer draft for them. You send the offer in Billify after you check the preview.

useCases.title: Review open offers
useCases.text: List the newest offers with their line items, filtered by client or status. Open one for its amounts and dates.

useCases.title: Check invoice payment status
useCases.text: List the newest invoices and open one for its amounts, dates, payment status and QR reference.
